name: Round porous hide
label: Hides
lead: Round hide with a porous texture and one small entrance - a dark, enclosed retreat for small geckos, spiders and scorpions, and a humid hide.

description.html: This hide is shaped like a ball with one round entrance near the bottom, similar to a coconut or a nest. The surface is light brown, porous and knobbly, with whitish highlights. Inside it is completely dark and closed on all sides except the entrance.

The small entrance suits smaller animals: young leopard geckos, fat-tailed geckos, tarantulas and scorpions. They feel safe in a space like this because nothing can surprise them from the side or from above.

The closed shape with a small entrance holds moisture well, so this hide can work as a humid hide. Put a little slightly damp moss inside; humid air helps geckos shed their old skin more easily. Replace the moss when it dries out or gets dirty to prevent mold.

description.text: How to choose and care for it

description.html: Before buying, compare the entrance with the size of your animal; it should pass through easily. Place the hide on firm substrate, with the entrance facing a side where your animal can easily see it. Empty it once a week and wash it with warm water.
